title: Best Coffee Makers 2026: Drip, Cold Brew & More
summary: Most home coffee tastes flat because the machine never reaches the right brew temperature. We sorted 2026's drip makers down to 7 that get it right, from the best-in-class Moccamaster to a budget-friendly OXO. Pick wrong and you drink mediocre coffee every morning for years.
method: We started from lab and expert tests, including Consumer Reports and hands-on brew tests that check water temperature, bloom and extraction. Machines certified by the Specialty Coffee Association and those that score well for brew quality, ease of cleaning and reliability ranked higher. Each pick below is matched to a different kind of coffee drinker.
assumptions: Prices change often, so check the current price on Amazon before you buy. Capacity is listed in cups of about 5 oz, as machines measure it.

products.name: Technivorm Moccamaster KBGV Select
why: This is the machine coffee people buy once and keep for years: a copper heating element, a hand-built body and SCA certification.
If you drink drip every day, the daily gap in taste is the reason to pay more.
specs: Glass carafe with a hot plate
Made to be repaired, with a long warranty
cons: High price for a drip machine
No timer or app, so you cannot schedule a brew
Hot plate keeps coffee warm but can cook it if left too long

products.name: OXO Brew 9-Cup Coffee Maker
why: The sweet spot for most kitchens: SCA-certified temperature and brew time, a thermal carafe, and a timer, without Moccamaster money.
Coffee stays hot for hours with no burnt hot-plate taste.

Buy it if you change beans often. Skip it if one-button coffee is all you want.

intro: One number separates great home coffee from sour, flat coffee: how long the water stays between 195 and 205°F. Consumer Reports tests exactly that, and it is why two machines at the same price can taste nothing alike.
Black Friday is Nov 27, and coffee makers like these are often marked down around then. We re-check Amazon prices every day, so the price on each card is the current one when you read this.

tips.title: 4 mistakes that ruin good coffee
items: Buying a bigger pot than you drink.
Coffee loses flavor on a hot plate. Match the carafe to your household, or choose a thermal carafe.
Fresh beans matter more than the machine. Buy whole beans and use them within a few weeks of roasting.
Mineral buildup lowers the water temperature and slows the brew. Descale every month or two.
It means the machine meets set standards for brew temperature and time, so it is the quickest quality check on the box.

faq: What is the best coffee maker for most people?
The OXO Brew 9-Cup. It is SCA-certified, has a thermal carafe and a timer, and costs far less than the Moccamaster.
Is the Moccamaster worth the money?
If you drink drip coffee daily, yes. It is built to last and brews at the right temperature every time. If you drink a cup now and then, a cheaper pick is smarter.
Thermal keeps coffee hot without a hot plate, so it does not taste cooked later. Glass is fine if you finish the pot quickly.
Do I need cold brew too?
Only if you drink iced coffee regularly. The OXO cold brew maker makes a concentrate that keeps in the fridge for up to two weeks.
